propositions: Outbound differ reads raw vendor snapshot keys and diffs in vendor shape; inbound differ maps to canonical shape first — this asymmetry violates ADR 0035 §(d) and blocks epic bbf1 AC3.

Snapshot and baseline entries must be canonicalized via injected InboundMapper before any field comparison in outbound differ; vendor payloads are emitted only at the boundary via OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote().

InboundMapper output must include three new canonical keys (assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity) with fixed presence-guarded structure to replace vendor-shaped field reads; map_remote_to_local must tolerate partial _BASELINE_FIELDS dicts by emitting only keys whose vendor source is present.

Neutral field-comparison helpers (canonical names only) replace vendor-aware helpers (_diff_fields, _extract_jira_field, _assignee_matches); assignee resolver re-homed to OutboundMapper as resolve_assignee(local_value, remote_identity) -> (payload_value, authoritative, is_account_id).

Vendor-specific helpers (_diff_fields, _extract_jira_field, _assignee_matches, _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE) become adapter-internal in adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py; outbound_differ.py imports deleted and denylist enforced by AST test.

Characterization suite must prove old-vs-new decision equivalence across all status/priority maps, assignee shapes (accountId/emailAddress/displayName/both-empty), parent changes, ADF description fit+rstrip, inbound-directionality suppression, and partial baseline canonicalization with local-wins behavior unchanged.
